towns.name: Ang Mo Kio
towns.mrt: NSL · CCL (AMK · Mayflower)
towns.character: Heartland mature town with premium HDB resale performance. Strong schools catchment (Ai Tong, CHIJ St Nicholas). Bishan-AMK park corridor.
towns.upgrader_angle: AMK 5-room resale consistently commands a premium. Upgraders here typically price into CCR/RCR condo with strong CPF positions.

towns.name: Bedok
towns.mrt: EWL · DTL (Bedok · Tanah Merah · Kembangan · Bedok Reservoir · Bedok North)
towns.character: Largest mature town by HDB flats. Bedok Integrated Complex + mall cluster. Long-standing East Coast lifestyle catchment.
towns.upgrader_angle: Bedok upgraders often stay east (D15/D16) for school continuity. Bayshore TEL and Bedok CBD redevelopment = 5–10yr upside.

towns.name: Bishan
towns.mrt: NSL · CCL (Bishan)
towns.character: Blue-chip HDB town. Catholic High, Raffles Institution proximity drives consistent premium. Bishan-AMK park.
towns.upgrader_angle: Bishan HDB resale sets benchmarks. Upgraders here are high-income, often moving to D11 Novena / D20 Thomson for school proximity.

towns.name: Bukit Batok
towns.mrt: NSL · JRL future (Bukit Batok · Bukit Gombak)
towns.character: Nature-fronted mature town. Bukit Batok Nature Park, Little Guilin. JRL line unlocks new connectivity from 2027.
towns.upgrader_angle: JRL catalyst + Tengah proximity make this a watch-list town for upgraders timing entry into Jurong Lake District.

towns.name: Bukit Merah
towns.mrt: EWL · CCL (Redhill · Tiong Bahru · Queenstown · Outram Park)
towns.character: City-fringe mature town. SGH catchment, Tiong Bahru lifestyle spillover. Prime-adjacent HDB resale.
towns.upgrader_angle: One of the strongest HDB-to-private upgrade catchments — proximity to CCR means the progression step is short, not a leap.

towns.name: Bukit Panjang
towns.mrt: DTL · BPLRT (Bukit Panjang · Cashew · Hillview · Beauty World)
towns.character: DTL-driven mature town. Junction 10, Hillion Mall. Nature-fronted family suburbs.
towns.upgrader_angle: Upgraders often move to Hillview/Dairy Farm (D23) condos — keeps the west/nature lifestyle.

towns.name: Bukit Timah
towns.mrt: DTL (Tan Kah Kee · Sixth Avenue · King Albert Park)
towns.character: Small HDB count (~2k flats). Old estates like Toh Yi, Queen Astrid. School-driven (Nanyang, Methodist Girls, NJC).
towns.upgrader_angle: Few HDB upgraders here — the stock is niche. Those upgrading typically go to D10/D11 condo within the same school zones.

towns.name: Central Area
towns.mrt: Multiple (Raffles Place · City Hall · Chinatown · Telok Ayer)
towns.character: CBD heartland HDB. Pinnacle@Duxton iconic stack. Chinatown, Pearl's Hill City Park.
towns.upgrader_angle: Pinnacle resale consistently the most expensive HDB nationally. Upgrade trajectory typically into D1/D2 condos.

towns.name: Choa Chu Kang
towns.mrt: NSL · JRL future · BPLRT (Choa Chu Kang · Yew Tee)
towns.character: Affordable mature town. Lot One mall. CCK nature park adjacency.
towns.upgrader_angle: Price-sensitive upgraders often stay west — Hillview/CCK EC and private condos offer the natural step up.

towns.name: Clementi
towns.mrt: EWL (Clementi · Dover)
towns.character: NUS catchment. Clementi Mall, 321 Clementi. Established family suburb with strong rental demand from academic + Science Park tenants.
towns.upgrader_angle: Clementi HDB upgraders often target D5 Pasir Panjang/West Coast or D21 Ulu Pandan — keeps the west-side school continuity.

towns.name: Geylang
towns.mrt: EWL · DTL (Aljunied · Kallang · Paya Lebar · Mountbatten · MacPherson)
towns.character: Paya Lebar Quarter anchor. Mixed-use gentrifying zones. Old freehold pockets in neighbouring D14.
towns.upgrader_angle: Upgraders here often move one step across to D14 Geylang/Paya Lebar condos — short geographic step, big price jump.

towns.name: Hougang
towns.mrt: NEL (Hougang · Kovan · Buangkok)
towns.character: Family-suburban North-East. Heartland mature town with strong Kovan food + retail pull.
towns.upgrader_angle: Hougang upgraders often target Serangoon Garden landed or D19 condos — keeps the NEL corridor + school zones.

towns.name: Jurong East
towns.mrt: EWL · NSL · JRL future (Jurong East · Chinese Garden · Lakeside)
towns.character: Jurong Lake District core. JCube redevelopment (the Hyatt). Singapore's long-dated regional CBD bet.
towns.upgrader_angle: High-upside upgrade zone. JLD masterplan + JRL + KL HSR revival rumors = asymmetric option. OCR upgraders positioned here catch the whole wave.

towns.name: Jurong West
towns.mrt: EWL · JRL future (Boon Lay · Lakeside · Pioneer)
towns.character: Largest by area in the west. NTU catchment. Boon Lay Place food, Taman Jurong, Jurong Point mall.
towns.upgrader_angle: Price-sensitive. Upgraders here tend to stay west (J-Town, Hillview, or JLD-adjacent ECs like Sembawang/Senja).

towns.name: Kallang / Whampoa
towns.mrt: EWL · DTL · NEL (Kallang · Lavender · Bendemeer · Boon Keng)
towns.character: Stadium + Kallang Alive precinct redevelopment. Novena Health Hub adjacent. City-fringe rising.
towns.upgrader_angle: One of the strongest city-fringe HDB catchments. Upgraders have short geographic jump to D8/D12 condos.

towns.name: Marine Parade
towns.mrt: TEL (Marine Parade · Marine Terrace · Siglap)
towns.character: Small HDB count (~6k flats), mature East Coast lifestyle. TEL extension changed the game in 2024.
towns.upgrader_angle: Marine Parade upgraders rarely leave the east — target D15 condos (Amber, Mountbatten, Katong) for continuity.

towns.name: Pasir Ris
towns.mrt: EWL · CRL future (Pasir Ris)
towns.character: Coastal family suburb. Pasir Ris park, Downtown East. CRL Pasir Ris interchange = 2030+ upgrade.
towns.upgrader_angle: Pasir Ris upgraders often step into D18 Tampines/Pasir Ris condos (e.g., Pinery Residences 2026 anchor).

towns.name: Punggol
towns.mrt: NEL · LRT (Punggol · Damai · Oasis · Kadaloor)
towns.character: Singapore's digital district. Punggol Digital District (PDD) + SIT campus. New HDB, young families dominant.
towns.upgrader_angle: Punggol BTO MOPs (2024-2028 wave) = largest upgrader cohort in SG. Typical path: sell 4-5rm BTO, buy D19 condo. Watch the MOP clock carefully.

towns.name: Queenstown
towns.mrt: EWL · CCL (Queenstown · Commonwealth · Redhill)
towns.character: Oldest HDB town but consistently premium. Redhill, Margaret Drive, Stirling. Mature MRT + ANS/RGS schools nearby.
towns.upgrader_angle: Queenstown HDB resale consistently outperforms. Upgraders here often move to D3 Queenstown / D5 condos with minimal disruption.

towns.name: Sembawang
towns.mrt: NSL (Sembawang · Canberra)
towns.character: North heartland, JB-RTS catchment (post-2027). Sembawang Shopping Centre, Canberra Plaza. EC-heavy pipeline.
towns.upgrader_angle: Sembawang EC 2026 launches are the upgrade vehicle for many residents here. Patience play — the town is still maturing.

towns.name: Sengkang
towns.mrt: NEL · LRT (Sengkang · Buangkok · Ranggung)
towns.character: Young family suburb. Compass One, waterway plays. Big BTO MOP cohort through 2025-2028.
towns.upgrader_angle: Similar to Punggol — large MOP upgrade wave. Typical trajectory: upgrade to D19 condo or HDB 5rm in Hougang/Serangoon.

towns.name: Serangoon
towns.mrt: NEL · CCL (Serangoon · Lorong Chuan · Bartley)
towns.character: Serangoon Garden + NEX mall + mature estate. Strong school catchment (ACS, Maris Stella).
towns.upgrader_angle: Premium HDB resale performer. Upgraders often target D19 Serangoon landed-adjacent or D13 Potong Pasir condos.

towns.name: Tampines
towns.mrt: EWL · DTL · CRL future (Tampines · Tampines East · Tampines West · Simei)
towns.character: Regional centre of the East. Tampines Hub (integrated complex). IKEA, Century Square, Tampines Mall.
towns.upgrader_angle: Strong upgrade corridor to D18 Tampines/Pasir Ris condos. Pinery Residences (2026) and Eden Tampines are the anchor launches.

towns.name: Toa Payoh
towns.mrt: NSL (Toa Payoh · Braddell)
towns.character: Iconic oldest second HDB town (after Queenstown). CHIJ Toa Payoh, SAJC zone. HDB Hub itself.
towns.upgrader_angle: TP HDB resale strong. Upgraders typically move to D11 Novena / D12 Balestier — 10-min drive, big price delta.

towns.name: Woodlands
towns.mrt: NSL · TEL · JB-RTS future (Woodlands · Marsiling · Admiralty · Woodlands North)
towns.character: Causeway corridor, JB-RTS terminus (2027). Woodlands Regional Centre. Causeway Point.
towns.upgrader_angle: JB-RTS catalyst + MY-buyer demand = interesting upgrade angle. D25 Kranji/Woodlands condos are the natural step.

towns.name: Yishun
towns.mrt: NSL (Yishun · Khatib · Canberra)
towns.character: North regional hub. Northpoint City, KTPH, SAF facilities. Big integrated transport hub.
towns.upgrader_angle: Yishun upgraders often target D27 Yishun/Sembawang ECs and condos — short geographic move, easier progression step.
